summary: Q2 revenue of $234.1m fell slightly below the true $236–240m bar, but 36.1% GAAP margin, 41.5% non-GAAP margin and a $8.8m adjusted EBITDA loss beat materially. Q3 guidance of $250–265m decisively clears the $238–243m maintain bar. That forward surprise outweighs heavy ATM issuance, lower guided margins and ambiguous Neutron Q4 pad-delivery wording, though those conflicts prevent a stronger signal.
